root.label: Food crisis export restrictions and global rice wheat prices

events.label: Food crisis export restrictions and global rice wheat prices

slots.name: rice price contribution
slots.sentence: During the 2006-08 food crisis, export restrictions and other policies that limited supplies reaching international markets were estimated to account for roughly 45% of the increase in world rice prices and nearly 30% of the increase in world wheat prices.

slots.name: wheat price contribution
slots.sentence: nearly 30% of the increase in world wheat prices.
